'''Rod Latham Endor Uprising''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Rod Latham]] and [[Alex Tennet]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls133.htm Endor Uprising], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041027134730/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls133.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Rod Latham]] and [[Alex Tennet]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising / Liberation|SE-L-localuprising.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Mains And Toys
